test_centerpoint_fpn: test the SECONDFPN neck with CenterPoint and original SECOND configurations using build_backbone and build_neck
build_backbone_SECOND: build a SECOND backbone model with configurable in_channels, out_channels, layer_nums, and layer_strides via build_backbone
build_neck_SECONDFPN: build a SECONDFPN neck model with configurable upsample_strides, in_channels, and out_channels via build_neck

compare_FPN_configurations: compare CenterPoint FPN and original SECOND FPN output shapes using the same backbone features
